source: imports validated registry lemma proofs/lem-maincb-full-corner-identification — There is a universal e_full > 0 such that, if R is a t-projection in an extended t-C*-algebra and ||R-I|| <= t <= e_full, then Co_R = I and S_R = A, at every amplification.
